title: 两片不等宽平面相交的薄片体

source_feature.meaning: On an open sheet with unequal finite supports, compare trim_edges continuing along every underlying boundary against trim_bound reaching widest support boundary with constant-parameter blend side edges.

parts_geometry_immutable: Wallx0..48/z0..32, floor trapezoid exact four vertices, one shared edge, zero thickness.
input.coincident_coplanar_face_merge_allowed: only if no contract topology is lost

semantic.target: two finite zero-thickness planar faces sewn along one edge

world_edge_fingerprints.curve_matching: world position/shape and finite adjacency; analytic fit can be recovered from NURBS, never require same curve class or same topology index

selection.expected_count_applies_to: geometric root chains/support intersections, not arbitrary backend edge segmentation

trigger_preconditions.condition: Keep angled expanding floor sides; equal rectangular supports would hide intended mode difference.

independent_oracles.assertion: Output remains a valid open sheet, zero solid volume/0 material solids; check face adjacency/free-boundary loops, not manifold-solid predicate.

Trim_edges tracks respective actual finite support side boundaries continuously; trim_bound reaches widest-boundary extent and has constant blend parameters on its side edges. Measure side curve positions/parameters from output, not colors.
Both modes use exact same finite faces, contact conditions and R; no thickening, rectangular replacement or independent face enlargement.
independent_oracles.visual: Side boundary close-ups overlay original finite wall/floor edges and actual two-mode blend boundaries.

visual_difference_requirements: Keep stable number and original/input/actual-result three columns.
Show trigger region before/after, intended stop or overlap boundary, and true output edges; helper geometry is labeled.
Side boundary close-ups overlay original finite wall/floor edges and actual two-mode blend boundaries.

native_API_mapping.reason: The existing ordinary fillet entry does not itself encode this source option. Capability requires explicit native mapping or a separately labeled composition; missing adapter is not proof of kernel unsupported.

source_clarifications_required: Source direction/mode semantics known, but the exact scalar coordinate of every expected side trim needs implementation against actual blend parameterization; no numeric output oracle yet frozen.

scoring.source_feature_score_requires: trigger satisfied AND correct mode/selection supplied AND target-specific oracles passed AND common quality gates passed
